cohort: 27 patients attending a Fistula centre in Dhaka Medical College and Hospital (DMCH) for surgical repair of genitourinary fistula
finding: The success rate of genitourinary fistula repair was higher for fistulas caused by gynecological procedures (87.50%) compared to obstetric causes (42.11%), and success was significantly higher in the first surgical attempt (90%) compared to subsequent attempts (20%).
